Fill in the blank with the correctly spelt word.

Their explanation was filled with _______, making it hard to discern the truth.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
